ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >98% of the visible ventral surface, resulting in a extremely low macro-level contrast ratio for the fluke body itself relative to the high-intensity (white) sky background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Near-uniform solid black pigmentation across both lobes. Small, high-contrast contiguous white geometric blobs are localized at the extreme distal tips (left and right terminals).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped central depression dividing the lobes; estimated pixel angle of ~35 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge. Visible variations include multiple peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from fine jaggedness to larger, deeper notches on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature sweeping from the median notch towards the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the far-left and far-right distal margins, corresponding to visible barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, fine, vertical white linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible along the upper trailing edge of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and deep notches along the trailing edge; white barnacle clusters present on the lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Brownish-red organic filament (likely kelp or algae) attached to and trailing from the far-left distal tip.
